description: The historic public library of Roslyn village, the oldest in Nassau County, which runs free programs and afternoon concerts for the community.
factsSource: Checked October 4, 2026. Sources: web.archive.org, bryantlibrary.org, bryantlibrary.libcal.com, en.wikipedia.org.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Free event; registration through the library calendar. ZIP 11576 is the standard Roslyn ZIP (the Bing listing gave no ZIP).

Directory research 2026-10-04: bryantlibrary.org sits behind a Cloudflare bot check (HTTP 403 for scripts), so its pages and the logo file were read from Internet Archive copies (Feb-Mar 2026); the logo SVG is the library's own site icon. The footer email info@bryantlibrary.org is hidden by Cloudflare email protection and was decoded from the archived page; LibCal also lists publicrelations@bryantlibrary.org. The site links Facebook as /pages/The-Bryant-Library/91630034807; current data has facebook.com/bryantlibrary/ (also used by Bing), likely the same page but not confirmed, so the site-linked URL is given. No photos: none of the library building or concert room were found on the library's own pages, and map/review photos are not allowed. Bing also lists a separate Roberta Balfus Book Store at 1 Paper Mill Rd (library's used-book shop).
hours: Mon-Tue 9 AM-8 PM; Wed 10 AM-8 PM; Thu-Fri 9 AM-8 PM; Sat 9 AM-5 PM; Sun 1 PM-5 PM (Sundays Oct 4, 2026-May 2, 2027 only)

logo.alt: Green line drawing of the Bryant Library building in Roslyn, with its cupola, arched windows and columned entrance among trees

evidence.note: Library's own home page (archived Feb 2026, live site blocks automated visits): 2 Paper Mill Rd, Roslyn, NY 11576, 516-621-2240, links to Facebook, Instagram, X, TikTok and YouTube.
Hours page (read via a March 2026 archive copy): Mon-Fri mostly 9 AM-8 PM (Wed from 10 AM), Sat 9-5, Sun 1-5, and a note that Sundays are open Oct 4, 2026-May 2, 2027.
Library's LibCal event calendar, used for program registration; its location record lists publicrelations@bryantlibrary.org as a contact.
